# P5 authority deployment TCB boundary V1

The owner-signed TCB manifest uses exact file membership. It binds the app-v3
runtime, migration, Amendment D engineering object, evaluator, isolated entry
points, live researchctl wrapper, base unit, owner drop-in, APSW wheel and its
extracted members, the exact CPython executable, the complete
/usr/lib/python3.12 tree, and the dynamic libraries resolved by CPython/APSW.

The deploy phase verifies bundle bytes before installation, installs only
manifest members, rehashes live paths, verifies the platform exact set, and
verifies the live systemd unit before systemctl daemon-reload.

The Linux kernel, systemd manager executable, SSH daemon executable, coreutils
used during the administrative cutover, firmware and hypervisor are outside
this application TCB. They are the pre-existing OS/platform administration
boundary, not authority application bytes. This package does not claim to
replace general OS supply-chain verification. Any observed package-manager or
secure-boot integrity failure remains fail-closed for the ceremony.

No directory wildcard is trusted: directories are containers only; every
regular file or symlink accepted under an exact-set root appears in a signed
manifest entry.
